CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel: Saul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel: Saul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Leadership in Israel: Saul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Leadership in Israel: Saul has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel: Saul.

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

3. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings on Prayer? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings on Prayer.

   D. Apply the teaching of Teachings on Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   C. Apply the teaching of Faith and God’s Promises with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Faith and God’s Promises has no place in daily life.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting

   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. Which response best shows understanding of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5? (1 mark)
